scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names shared,api,desktop "npm run dev -w @bcis/shared" "npm run dev -w @bcis/api" "npm run dev -w @bcis/desktop"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @bcis/shared && npm run dev -w @bcis/api
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @bcis/shared && npm run dev -w @bcis/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bcis/shared && npm run build -w @bcis/api && npm run build -w @bcis/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bcis/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @bcis/shared && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
